Capability Gate Policy
nodes.rationale: A gate should represent a scientifically usable capability; routine corrections remain inside the current gate unless they materially change semantics, scope, data, accounting, execution, or frozen architecture.

nodes.label: Engine Validation Is Not Edge Evidence
nodes.rationale: Runs lacking borrow, locate, SSR, halt, liquidity, and capacity realism may validate mechanics but cannot support profitability or edge claims.

nodes.label: Graphify Semantic Navigation Layer
nodes.rationale: Graphify supports navigation but does not replace contracts, tests, manifests, physical evidence, handoffs, or gate reviews.

nodes.label: Controlled Corpus Authority Boundary
nodes.rationale: Current implementation material and physical gate evidence are separated into distinct leaves to avoid mixing living authority with controlled evidence or archive history.

nodes.label: RunPreflight Before Data Consumption
nodes.rationale: Market data cannot enter the engine until dataset, universe, price views, temporal policy, missing-data policy, corporate-action policy, and limitations are resolved.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Data Preflight
nodes.rationale: Unresolved or unauthorized data context must stop the run before any market data becomes visible to the engine.

nodes.label: Gap Events Without Imputation
nodes.rationale: Interior missing minutes are represented explicitly as ReplayGapEvent instances so replay does not invent market facts.

nodes.label: Backtest-Specific State Authorization Boundary
nodes.rationale: A provider response or materialized dataset is insufficient; state consumption also requires exact contract identities, complete request-response correspondence, official downstream status, and explicit authorization for backtesting.

nodes.label: State and Execution Separation
nodes.rationale: State is a decision input and cannot bypass ExecutionModel or HistoricalReplayFeed to become a fill-price source.

nodes.label: Execution Semantics and Cost Model Contract V0.1
No Same-Bar Lookahead
nodes.rationale: A decision formed after a bar becomes observable cannot receive a fill from inside that already observed interval.

nodes.label: Deterministic Fill Simulator Implementation and Acceptance
Scientific Hash Boundary
nodes.rationale: Scientific identity covers causally relevant inputs and outputs while excluding volatile host, path, process, and wall-clock fields.

nodes.label: BT-GATE-014 Point-in-Time Market State Consumer Contract V0.1
One New Boundary Principle
nodes.rationale: The gate introduces only the bounded point-in-time Market State consumer and store so that one primary uncertainty is tested without simultaneously opening Event State, strategy, execution, optimization, or historical scaling.

nodes.label: Point-in-Time State Availability
nodes.rationale: State delivery is legal only when the event-loop clock reaches state_available_at_utc, preventing look-ahead and separating decision time, as-of time, and availability time.

nodes.label: BT-GATE-014 Non-Physical Consumer Acceptance Packet V0.1
Atomic Market State Validation and Sealing
nodes.rationale: Validation and receipt issuance are atomic so the store can accept only an event sealed against its content, authority, structural schema, and consumed sidecar identity.
